child.text:
[{"insert":"Back Squat
 
The back squat is the main lower body strength work this cycle. The 33X1 tempo means three seconds down, three seconds held in the bottom, then drive up fast and stand tall for one. That long pause kills the bounce, so every rep starts from a dead stop and the legs do all of it. Reps drop across the odd weeks, from five here to three and then two, so the weight climbs each time it comes back.
"}]
